about_the_game:
The flames that consumed your noble house also erased your past, leaving you with haunting questions and a signet ring, a final memento from the mother you barely remember. 

Raised in seclusion by your aunt in the remote mountains, you’ve longed for a life beyond the peaks. When the opportunity arises to serve as a governess to the imperial family, it feels like fate: a new beginning in the glittering capital, access to the imperial archives, and perhaps, answers to the mysteries of your past.

The palace offers luxury, knowledge, and the chance to move among the empire’s most influential. This includes two dangerously handsome princes:

Maximilian Windrake, the Crimson Reaper

Respected and feared by friend and foe alike, he is a man who never loses, never retreats, and never shows weakness. Yet beneath his flawless exterior, you glimpse something dangerously… human. Can you win the heart of a man who has conquered kingdoms but never learned to surrender?


Lucian Windrake, the Enigmatic Enchanter

Charming, clever, and unpredictable, he collects secrets as easily as others collect coin. Every glance is a riddle, every word a test. Being near him is a thrilling dance on the knife’s edge between desire and deception. Will you match his game, or let the danger of him consume you?

Every choice shapes your path. Will you uncover the truth that cost your family their lives, or will it destroy you? Will you capture the heart of a prince, or let love slip into betrayal? The empire teeters on the edge of chaos. Which side will you choose? Will you broker a lasting peace, or watch the world burn? 

Love. Secrets. Power. The choices are yours. Step into Fate's Masquerade, your story awaits!

  • Customizable Heroine: Name your heroine and forge your own path through the empire.

  • Two Unique Routes: Completely different love stories with distinct personalities and secrets

  • 8+ Endings: Your choices determine everything: love, betrayal, triumph, and tragedy.

  • Spicy Scenes: Your hard work will be rewarded with steamy moments with the princes.

  • Animated Spirits & CGs: Animated sprites and stunning CGs breathe life into every scene.

content_descriptors.notes: Fate's Masquerade contains mature themes, and player discretion is advised. These include but are not limited to violence, blood, murder, human death, animal death, strong language, alcohol references, and sexual references.

short_description: Step into a world of political intrigue and dangerous romance in this visual novel. Uncover the mystery of your family’s past as you navigate a glittering imperial court filled with secrets and betrayal. Every choice shapes your fate toward love, power, freedom…or ruin.
